newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Michell to fund buyback with property.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Michell to fund buyback with property.

text.p: Privately-held Australian wool processor G.H Michell and Sons Holdings Pty Ltd said on Monday it would fund a buy-out involving 46 percent of shares through refinancing and the sale of New South Wales pastoral properties.

Chairman Raymond Michell said in a statement that while ensuring the future control of the company and its assets remained within the Michell family, the buy-out plan was initiated following the expressed desire of a group of shareholders to exit the company on fair terms.
Michell did not give a value to the buy-out but local media reports estimated it at between A$150 million and A$200 million.
"Because we are a fifth generation family business, I think it is quite understandable, in fact inevitable, that some shareholders from time to time want to sell," Michell said.
"The board has resolved to fund the share buy-out through the sale of its New South Wales pastoral properties and the refinancing of the remainder of the business," he said.
A family dispute over a buy-back last year was taken to the Supreme Court of South Australia but was settled out of court. Michell could not be contacted for further comment.
